name: Battery Guard
description: Keeps the pack in a charge window so a permanently-powered unit does not sit at 100%.

settings.label: Stop charging at
settings.help: Li-ion ages fastest held at high state of charge. 80 is the usual compromise between longevity and useful reserve.

settings.label: Resume charging below
settings.help: Must be below max_percent. A wide window means fewer charge cycles; a narrow one keeps the reserve more predictable.

settings.label: Safety floor
settings.help: Charging is force-resumed below this level whatever else is configured. This is the backstop against a misconfigured window draining the unit.

settings.label: Control method
settings.help: auto probes each node for writability at start. Pin it only if detection picks a node that misbehaves on this kernel.
